purpose: Audit the fixed Raps newborn sex split used by every production fertility path.
source: Raps technical specification already recorded in model_data.parameters.sexRatioMaleAtBirthSource
requiredChecks: production parameter equals 0.515 male and 0.485 female
male and female newborn shares sum exactly to 1
the same split is used in the ordinary and birth-status simulation engines
changing only the sex split must not change total births in the first forecast year
the historical Lulea FA male birth share diagnostic remains visible but does not tune the production parameter
governance: The fixed Raps split is not estimated from Lulea outcomes.
Observed local male-birth share is diagnostic only because annual/local sex ratios are noisy.
Any future replacement of 0.515 requires a new documented source and regression validation.
